comp_analysis.reasoning: The same west-city market and colonial design provide a useful comparison. Subject's substantially greater above-grade area, fourth bedroom, additional full bath and larger apparent exclusive parcel support an upward adjustment from this sale. Subject's older construction, built-under garage and sloping site offset some of that advantage. C1 has slightly more finished basement area. The packet does not establish defensible dollar adjustment rates.

The recent sale and immediate proximity provide strong location evidence. Its larger wooded lot, grade-level three-car garage, ranch layout and main-floor bedroom support a downward adjustment to its sale price when estimating Subject. Subject's larger above-grade area, fourth bedroom, additional full bath and more updated finishes offset part of those advantages. Different design and unverified storage utility limit comparability; dollar adjustment rates are unsupported.

Similar age, colonial design, four bedrooms and west-city location make this a useful lower reference. Subject's reported total finished area is greater, its apparent exclusive parcel is larger, and it has an additional half bath and nominally greater garage capacity, supporting an upward adjustment. Unknown grade split and unreviewed interior condition materially reduce its weight. Subject's garage access and slope may offset some advantages.

result.rationale: Three completed 2026 sales provide sufficient evidence for a broad market-value opinion. The subject appears to warrant a material premium over the two smaller colonial references, while the nearby custom ranch provides an upper reference with superior land and garage utility. A midpoint of $600,000 reconciles those relationships without assuming that extra square footage or acreage contributes at average sale-price rates. The interval reflects weak adjustment support and material condition and parcel uncertainty. The 2017 subject sale is too remote to translate into current value without market-trend and improvement evidence.
assumptions: The supplied sales are completed arm's-length transactions with no material undisclosed concessions.
Subject's stated living areas, bedroom count and bathroom count are materially accurate and legally usable.
Exclusive parcel area is approximately 0.536 acres pending survey; the larger listing claim is not relied upon.
The property has no material undisclosed structural, moisture, mechanical, title or access defects.
No time adjustment is applied because the packet supplies no local appreciation or depreciation evidence.
missing_evidence: Verified sale concessions, transaction terms and arm's-length status.
Matched-sale evidence supporting size, bathroom, lot, garage, design and condition adjustments.
Inspection of foundation, retaining walls, deck, steps, drainage, steam shower and mechanical systems.
Survey establishing exclusive parcel boundaries and acreage.
Verified C3 above-grade and below-grade areas and interior condition.
Local market-trend evidence between each comparable sale and the valuation date.

receipt.limitations: Fresh-context, packet-only instructions and exposure attestations; shared Work tools/files are not access-isolated. Hashes detect changes, not proof of blindness.
